name: Csobád (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and black triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csobád: a shield of red and blue with a yellow sun crest and white mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed CSOBÁD.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
